answer: Because the copper measurement is attested to the quartz verifier, the vine audit records each device and an extracted key fails to sign. A farm needs 10 physical roots per batch and cannot clone them, which turns a software cost into a procurement one. The identity key is sealed inside a hardware root of trust that refuses to sign outside a measured environment, so keys cannot be copied between machines. A farm of 233 pays that 56 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
